records.dataset_name: Deep learning-based automatic segmentation of MRONJ lesions on CBCT images - publication assets
records.sample_count: 52 clinically and pathologically confirmed MRONJ patients
records.modality: CBCT publication figures and segmentation examples
records.labels: three oral and maxillofacial radiologists produced consensus lesion annotations; downloaded assets contain only article figures, including labeling and raw/ground-truth/prediction examples
records.clinical_variables: age range 47-83; no sex-stratified analysis; raw patient table unavailable
records.recommended_use: target-near visual reference, annotation protocol design and MRONJ lesion segmentation evidence
records.data_availability: original CBCT and NIfTI data are available only from the corresponding author on reasonable request
records.data_boundary: No downloadable patient volumes or voxel masks are present. The figures cannot support model training or target-domain performance claims.

records.dataset_name: Spatial and temporal patterns in DCE fluorescence imaging of bone perfusion during leg amputation
records.license: CC BY 4.0 for the Figshare supplement; Optica open-access article license for publication figures
records.sample_count: 12 adult below-knee amputation patients; 3.5 million ROIs from 9 patients for cross-validation and 3 additional patients for generalization
records.modality: paired white-light and dynamic ICG near-infrared fluorescence publication figures
records.labels: unsupervised normal, suspicious and compromised perfusion categories derived from 21 spatiotemporal features
records.clinical_variables: patient grouping and controlled baseline, osteotomy and periosteal-stripping conditions; no downloadable patient-level table
records.recommended_use: continuous activity-score design, three-level gray-zone taxonomy, temporal feature engineering and abstention logic
records.data_availability: the repository supplement is a PDF; direct Figshare access returned HTTP 403 in this environment. Seven license-compatible article figures were downloaded from the NCBI CDN.
records.data_boundary: Publication figures expose the method and representative maps, without raw fluorescence sequences, patient-level masks or jaw disease labels.

records.dataset_name: Intraoperative assessment of bone viability through DCE fluorescence imaging - technique report assets
records.sample_count: 3 patients: chronic infected tibial nonunion, acute open distal tibial fracture and chronic atrophic humeral nonunion
records.modality: ICG fluorescence intensity and kinetic maps with color surgical views
records.labels: case-level condition and pre/post-debridement spatial perfusion examples; no downloadable pixel ground truth
records.clinical_variables: case diagnosis and surgical stage only
records.recommended_use: pre/post-debridement activity-map engineering and visual report validation
records.data_boundary: Three-case technique evidence only; it cannot establish calibrated necrotic, transitional or viable jaw-bone labels.

records.dataset_name: NIR fluorescence bone perfusion during elective non-union surgery - publication assets
records.sample_count: 20 valid patients at 7 fracture locations; 3 patients had simultaneous fracture-related infection
records.modality: ICG NIR fluorescence, ROI selections and time-intensity curves
records.labels: three observed perfusion patterns: rapid ingress/egress, rapid ingress with plateau, prolonged ingress without measured egress
records.clinical_variables: age, sex, race, BMI, medical history, smoking and injury location described in study; no downloadable row-level table
records.recommended_use: temporal activity-score features and patient-context schema reference
records.data_boundary: The images and curves are publication assets. Patient-level video, ROI coordinates and outcome-linked masks are unavailable.

records.dataset_name: ICG angiography of vascularized medial femoral condyle grafts for scaphoid nonunion
records.sample_count: 7 patients with scaphoid nonunion; 2 had proximal-pole osteonecrosis on preoperative MRI
records.modality: ICG angiography figures and one MPEG supplementary video
records.labels: case-level graft/periosteum perfusion observations; no pixel masks
records.clinical_variables: age, sex, prior graft, injury interval and MRI viability are reported in the article table
records.recommended_use: real fluorescence-video ingestion, temporal signal and bone-graft perfusion proxy
records.data_boundary: The video shows perfusion of a vascularized graft, without osteomyelitis, jaw necrosis classes or validated spatial activity labels.

records.dataset_name: ICG fluorescence perfusion scale and postoperative wound necrosis in bone and soft-tissue surgery
records.sample_count: 22 musculoskeletal oncology patients; 10 developed postoperative wound necrosis
records.modality: color surgical view, ICG angiography and postoperative wound outcome figures
records.labels: patient-level fluorescence perfusion scale types 1, 2 and 3 with postoperative necrosis outcome
records.clinical_variables: age, sex, BMI, pathology, site, implants, therapies and outcome appear in article tables; row-level source data require author request
records.recommended_use: ordinal perfusion-class and outcome-association logic reference
records.data_boundary: The endpoint is predominantly wound/soft-tissue necrosis after oncology surgery. It cannot serve as jaw-bone activity ground truth.

search_conclusion.evans_blue: No license-clear, directly downloadable bone-viability or jaw-osteonecrosis imaging dataset was identified in this audit. Evans blue remains a literature or wet-lab validation candidate.
search_conclusion.target_domain_gap: No public dataset found here combines intraoperative jaw white-light/fluorescence frames, physician-reviewed bone-surface masks, necrotic-transition-viable pixel labels, pathology mapping and patient clinical variables.
search_conclusion.admission_rule: Every downloaded record remains target_domain_flag=false and training_eligible=false until content, license, physician review and task-specific admission gates pass.
